full_judgment: Heard the learned Advocate for the petitioner on the application under section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1908 for condonation of the delay of 60 (sixty) days in filing the revisional application under section 439 read with section 435 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1898 (shortly CrPC) against order dated 8-11-2018 by which the learned Metropolitan Additional Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka in Sessions Case No. 14770 of 2016, framed charge against the accused petitioner under sections 302/34/ 109/212/120B of the Penal Code upon rejecting his application for discharge under section 265C of the CrPC.
